title: US Treasury yields rise as Fed's Waller presses rate hike case - The Economic Times
text:
Following remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, short-dated Treasury yields saw an uptick, as he proposed the necessity of action despite seemingly moderated inflation data. Waller highlighted a possible half-point rate increase if inflation intensifies, signaling potential shifts in monetary policy. Economists expect a modest rise in core inflation, guiding market anticipations as money markets now fully reflect a 25 basis point increase in December.

India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits. Banks have been in discussions with industry associations and clearinghouses for potential solutions and better pricing information.
